question: How many open shipping-related support tickets do our strategic accounts have in total?

metrics.name: deliveries_90d
metrics.label: Deliveries (90 days)
metrics.definition: The number of non-cancelled deliveries whose requested delivery date falls in the 90 days ending on the as-of date.

metrics.name: on_time_deliveries_90d
metrics.label: On-time deliveries (90 days)
metrics.definition: Of the deliveries in the 90-day window, how many the carrier delivered on or before the date the customer asked for.

metrics.name: on_time_delivery_rate
metrics.label: On-time delivery rate (90 days)
metrics.definition: The share of deliveries that arrived on or before the customer's requested date, over the last 90 days. "Arrived" is the carrier's delivered event, not a ship date; cancelled deliveries do not count; a delivery not yet delivered by its date is late.

metrics.name: late_deliveries
metrics.label: Late deliveries (90 days)
metrics.definition: Deliveries in the last 90 days that arrived after the requested date, or have not arrived although the date has passed.

metrics.name: net_revenue
metrics.label: Net revenue (USD)
metrics.definition: Invoiced revenue minus credit memos, converted to US dollars at the monthly average exchange rate of each billing month.

metrics.name: open_shipping_tickets
metrics.label: Open shipping tickets
metrics.definition: Open support tickets about shipping: tagged shipping, delivery, late_delivery or logistics, or with a subject that mentions late, delay, shipment, delivery or tracking. Tickets on a look-alike duplicate account count toward the real customer.

metrics.name: renewals_due_120d
metrics.label: Renewals due in 120 days
metrics.definition: Open renewal opportunities that close within 120 days of the as-of date.

metrics.name: account_risk_flag
metrics.label: At-risk flag
metrics.definition: 1 when an account's on-time delivery rate is below 85% and it has two or more open shipping tickets or a renewal due in 120 days; otherwise 0. Combine with the strategic filter to get the at-risk strategic accounts.

dimensions.name: account__tier
dimensions.description: Tier at the end of the as-of date (today's tier).

dimensions.name: delivery__tier_at_delivery
dimensions.description: The customer's tier on the requested delivery date (history mode), not today's tier.

notes: Group by the entity `account` to get one row per customer, and `account__account_name` for its name.
`account__tier` is today's tier; `delivery__tier_at_delivery` is the tier in force on each delivery's date.
Delivery metrics already cover the 90 days ending on the as-of date (6 Nov 2026).

definitions.open_shipping_tickets: Open support tickets about shipping: tagged shipping, delivery, late_delivery or logistics, or with a subject that mentions late, delay, shipment, delivery or tracking. Tickets on a look-alike duplicate account count toward the real customer.

output.compiled_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(__open_shipping_tickets, 0) AS open_shipping_tickets
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(open_shipping_tickets) AS __open_shipping_tickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      accounts_src_10000.is_strategic AS account__is_strategic
      , subq_1.__open_shipping_tickets AS open_shipping_tickets
    FROM (
      SELECT
        customer_id AS account
        , case when is_open and is_shipping_related then 1 else 0 end AS __open_shipping_tickets
      FROM "warehouse"."marts"."fct_ticket" tickets_src_10000
    ) subq_1
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      "warehouse"."marts"."dim_account" accounts_src_10000
    ON
      subq_1.account = accounts_src_10000.customer_id
  ) subq_5
  WHERE account__is_strategic = true
) subq_8
LIMIT 100

definitions.open_shipping_tickets: Open support tickets about shipping: tagged shipping, delivery, late_delivery or logistics, or with a subject that mentions late, delay, shipment, delivery or tracking. Tickets on a look-alike duplicate account count toward the real customer.

SELECT
  account__account_name
  , COALESCE(__open_shipping_tickets, 0) AS open_shipping_tickets
FROM (
  SELECT
    account__account_name
    , SUM(open_shipping_tickets) AS __open_shipping_tickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      accounts_src_10000.account_name AS account__account_name
      , accounts_src_10000.is_strategic AS account__is_strategic
      , subq_1.__open_shipping_tickets AS open_shipping_tickets
    FROM (
      SELECT
        customer_id AS account
        , case when is_open and is_shipping_related then 1 else 0 end AS __open_shipping_tickets
      FROM "warehouse"."marts"."fct_ticket" tickets_src_10000
    ) subq_1
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      "warehouse"."marts"."dim_account" accounts_src_10000
    ON
      subq_1.account = accounts_src_10000.customer_id
  ) subq_5
  WHERE account__is_strategic = true
  GROUP BY
    account__account_name
) subq_8
LIMIT 100

answer.answer_summary: Our strategic accounts have 28 open shipping-related support tickets in total, per the open_shipping_tickets metric. Halbrook Fluid Systems and Galbury Steelworks SA have the most (3 and 4, respectively). Zendesk, the source of these tickets, has not synced successfully since 9 Nov and is outside its 24-hour window, so the count may be out of date.

The count uses the open_shipping_tickets definition as written, including tickets on look-alike duplicate accounts, which count toward the real customer.
The count is as of the latest data loaded, not strictly as of 6 Nov 2026.
